evals.name: inherited-polish-authorization
evals.prompt: The user asked: Rewrite the supplied README for concise English, preserving all code and claims. The parent writing skill has drafted the authorized target and invokes humanize-en on that same file. Complete the prose pass.
evals.expected_output: Read the target, perform the authorized prose edit and applicable checks, preserve code/links/claims and report the diff. No second Apply yes/no prompt is issued. Do not extend the target or publication scope.

evals.name: audit-file-stays-unchanged
evals.prompt: Audit the supplied README for AI writing tells. Propose improvements, but do not modify it.
evals.expected_output: Return findings and a proposed rewrite/diff, optionally validating a temporary candidate. The original file is byte-identical afterward. A prose filepath and mechanical checks do not turn an audit into edit authority.

evals.name: contextual-pattern-and-missing-parent
evals.prompt: Humanize this engineering README using our inherited brand rules. It uses important in a quoted API warning and lists three actual platform limits. The brand parent path does not exist.
evals.expected_output: Consult references/patterns.md to distinguish literal technical content from rhetorical AI tells; preserve the quote and factual list. Refuse to perform a supposedly brand-compliant rewrite with an unresolved parent. Report the exact failed resolution and missing path, and keep dependent edits pending until the brand input is repaired.

evals.name: sparse-facts-stay-sparse
evals.prompt: Humanize: Gallery 825 serves as the exhibition space. It boasts over 3,000 square feet. Experts believe its programme may affect attendance; the supplied source names no expert or study.
evals.expected_output: Preserve Gallery 825, over 3,000 square feet and the uncertain attributed attendance claim. Do not invent a study, year, source, room count or causal result. Simplify phrasing and identify the attribution gap without substituting new evidence.

evals.name: explicit-provenance-json-is-not-resolved-rules
evals.prompt: Validate the draft 'The launch is scheduled for Monday.' with --rules-json pointing to {"voice":{"name":"Synthetic"},"merged":{"forbidden_lexicon":["launch"]}}.
evals.expected_output: Reject the provenance-shaped input with an input error and exact --resolved-json guidance. Do not emit clean or silently ignore the nested rules. Preserve the draft while the brand input is invalid.
